# Exam 4

## 1. Mean (σ Known)

### Formula

$$
\bar{x} \pm z_{\alpha/2} \cdot \frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}
$$

### R Workflow

``` r
xbar       <- ___
sigma      <- ___
n          <- ___
conf_level <- 0.95

alpha <- 1 - conf_level
z     <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

SE <- sigma / sqrt(n)
E  <- z * SE

lower <- xbar - E
upper <- xbar + E

lower
upper
```

### What to Look For

-   σ is given → use z
-   Problem says "mean"

## 2. Mean (σ Unknown)

### Formula

$$
\bar{x} \pm t_{\alpha/2,df} \cdot \frac{s}{\sqrt{n}}
$$

### R Workflow

``` r
xbar       <- ___
s          <- ___
n          <- ___
conf_level <- 0.95

alpha <- 1 - conf_level
df    <- n - 1
tcrit <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df)

SE <- s / sqrt(n)
E  <- tcrit * SE

lower <- xbar - E
upper <- xbar + E

lower
upper
```

### What to Look For

-   σ not given
-   s is given → use t

## 3. Population Proportion

### Formula

$$
\hat{p} \pm z_{\alpha/2} \cdot \sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}
$$

### R Workflow

``` r
x          <- ___   # number of successes
n          <- ___
conf_level <- 0.95

phat <- round(x / n, 3)

alpha <- 1 - conf_level
z     <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

SE <- sqrt(phat * (1 - phat) / n)
E  <- z * SE

lower <- phat - E
upper <- phat + E

lower
upper
```

### Condition Check

``` r
n * phat
n * (1 - phat)
```

Both should be ≥ 10

### What to Look For

-   Words like: proportion, percent, defective, success/failure

## 4. Variance / Standard Deviation

### Formula

$$
\frac{(n-1)s^2}{\chi^2_{\alpha/2}} < \sigma^2 < \frac{(n-1)s^2}{\chi^2_{1-\alpha/2}}
$$

### R Workflow

``` r
s          <- ___
n          <- ___
conf_level <- 0.95

alpha <- 1 - conf_level
df    <- n - 1

chi_upper <- qchisq(1 - alpha/2, df)
chi_lower <- qchisq(alpha/2, df)

s2 <- s^2

lower_var <- (df * s2) / chi_upper
upper_var <- (df * s2) / chi_lower

lower_sd <- sqrt(lower_var)
upper_sd <- sqrt(upper_var)

lower_var
upper_var
lower_sd
upper_sd
```

### What to Look For

-   Mentions variance or standard deviation
-   Uses chi-square

## 5. X-bar Chart (μ and σ Known)

### Formulas

$$
UCL = \mu + 3\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}
$$

$$
CL = \mu
$$

$$
LCL = \mu - 3\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}
$$

### R Workflow

``` r
mu    <- ___
sigma <- ___
n     <- ___

UCL <- mu + 3 * sigma / sqrt(n)
CL  <- mu
LCL <- mu - 3 * sigma / sqrt(n)

UCL
CL
LCL
```

### Check Sample Means

``` r
xbar <- c(___, ___, ___)

xbar > UCL
xbar < LCL
```

## 6. X-bar and R Charts (σ Unknown)

### R Workflow

#### Step 1: Enter Data

``` r
data <- matrix(c(
  ___, ___, ___,
  ___, ___, ___,
  ___, ___, ___
), nrow = ___, byrow = TRUE)
```

#### Step 2: Compute Statistics

``` r
xbar <- rowMeans(data)
R    <- apply(data, 1, function(x) max(x) - min(x))

xbarbar <- mean(xbar)
Rbar    <- mean(R)
```

#### Step 3: Get Constants (from table in your notes)

``` r
A2 <- ___
D3 <- ___
D4 <- ___
```

#### Step 4: Compute Limits

``` r
UCL_xbar <- xbarbar + A2 * Rbar
CL_xbar  <- xbarbar
LCL_xbar <- xbarbar - A2 * Rbar

UCL_R <- D4 * Rbar
CL_R  <- Rbar
LCL_R <- D3 * Rbar
```

#### Step 5: Check Control

``` r
xbar > UCL_xbar | xbar < LCL_xbar
R > UCL_R | R < LCL_R
```

## 7. p-Chart

### Case 1: p Known

``` r
p <- ___
n <- ___
d <- c(___, ___, ___)

phat <- d / n

SE <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n)

UCL <- p + 3 * SE
CL  <- p
LCL <- max(0, p - 3 * SE)

phat > UCL | phat < LCL
```

### Case 2: p Unknown

``` r
n <- ___
d <- c(___, ___, ___)

m <- length(d)

phat <- d / n
pbar <- sum(d) / (m * n)

SE <- sqrt(pbar * (1 - pbar) / n)

UCL <- pbar + 3 * SE
CL  <- pbar
LCL <- max(0, pbar - 3 * SE)

phat > UCL | phat < LCL
```
